distribution.summary: Heilongjiang; Shaanxi; Qinghai; Sichuan; Yunnan; Fujian; Xizang; Taiwan; Gansu; Shanxi
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) records Heilongjiang (Dailing), Shaanxi (Mian County), Qinghai (Qilian, Guinan and Yushu), Sichuan (Nanjiang, Miyaluo and Shuajingsi), and Yunnan (Lijiang). Huang & Lu (2015) repeats these provinces and additionally lists Fujian and Xizang. Beaver & Liu (2010) records Taiwan and broadly states China, without supporting additional mainland province assignments. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Gansu, Qinghai, Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) lists nine species-level conifer hosts; Huang & Lu (2015) repeats these and additionally lists Pinus griffithii and Abies fabri. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Picea, Abies, Larix and Pinus broadly, with Picea sp. recorded as a Taiwan host. Existing genus-level host entries are retained without inferring a species-level Taiwan host. The 1984/2015 repeated records are not counted as independent host confirmations.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetes hectographus Reitter, 1913, VSN_2427, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. Beaver & Liu (2010) synonymized O. ater and D. formosanus with D. hectographus after type comparisons.
